baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنزَلْنَا ... ءَايَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ ... مَثَلًا ... مَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse sequences delivered material, visible disclosure, embodied precedent, heart-softening warning, and self-protection. The three objects are therefore stages of one pedagogy rather than an additive list.

activation_trace.role: إنزال الشيء وإيصاله supplies delivered material and makes reception the first stage.
علامة ظاهرة makes the delivered units perceptible signs rather than unmarked speech.
ظهور الشيء وانكشافه gives the signs their disclosive action.
المثل عبرة وآية turns prior lives into a concrete lesson-sign.
تذكير مخوِّف يرق له القلب converts disclosed precedent into affective warning.
جعل النفس في وقاية supplies the intended uptake: the hearer actively places the self behind protection.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists clear signs, an old example, and an admonition.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes a protective learning sequence: signs disclose, precedent embodies, warning penetrates, and the recipient converts all three into self-guarding.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَثَلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلِكُمْ
baseline_models.mechanism: Those people have temporally departed, yet the exemplar can stand and the before-image can face the current audience. The phrase stages absence as present confrontation.

activation_trace.role: مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن supplies the irretrievable departure of the former people.
المثول والانتصاب lets the exemplar stand before the reader despite that departure.
مواجهة الشيء للشيء contributes a face-to-face image within the ordinary temporal sense of before.
ظهور الشيء وانكشافه makes the staged past inspectable in the present.

changed_reading.before: The verse refers backward to information about former peoples.
changed_reading.after: The departed past is made to stand before the audience as a visible case that confronts the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier co-location of admonition, return, likeness, and unbounded duration makes the focus's historical exemplar a recurrence detector: the audience must recognize the reproducible shape of an act before it returns.

activation_trace.role: المثل المضروب anchors the focus as a formulated likeness.
مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن locates that likeness in a departed human past.
تذكير مخوِّف يرق له القلب supplies the same admonitory force in an explicit prevention construction.
رجوع بعد انصراف وتثنية بعد بدء supplies recurrence after an event has passed.
المثل المضروب names the repeatable likeness whose return is blocked.
طول المدة والدوام extends non-recurrence beyond the immediate incident.

structural_cues: 24:17 grammatically binds يَعِظُكُم to أَن تَعُودُوا لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَدًا.
24:34 recombines مَثَلًا and مَوْعِظَةً while adding departed predecessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies admonition plus return-to-a-likeness; I infer the arrow historical pattern -> recognition -> interruption. A live alternative is that 24:17's likeness remains local to its immediate incident rather than defining every historical example.

changed_reading.before: Past precedent illustrates a lesson already understood.
changed_reading.after: Past precedent teaches by exposing a repeatable form of conduct so that its recurrence can be interrupted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus formula is bracketed by prescription at the surah's opening and guidance toward a straight path at its later echo. Clarification therefore places conduct on an oriented course, not merely information in view.

activation_trace.role: وضع الشيء في منزلته lets the delivered signs place matters in their proper normative positions.
كشف المعنى بالقول أو العلامة anchors orientation in articulated clarification.
إلزام محدد بحد معلوم places bounded obligation beside the first sent-down clear-sign formula.
دلالة بلطف إلى الطريق والحق makes guidance the immediate consequence of the repeated formula.
الطريق المستقيم supplies the course onto which clarification directs the recipient.

structural_cues: 24:1 couples sent-down clear signs with وَفَرَضْنَاهَا and remembrance.
24:46 repeats لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا ءَايَاتٍ مُّبَيِّنَاتٍ and immediately continues with guidance to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prescription beside the opening formula and path-guidance after its later echo; I infer clarification -> normed orientation. The alternative is that prescription characterizes the surah globally without modifying every sign individually.

changed_reading.after: The signs clarify by assigning conduct its place and orienting the hearer onto a practicable course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding prohibition of coercion turns the focus's protection-language outward as well as inward. Admonition trains recipients not only to shield themselves but also to stop converting another person's vulnerability into gain.

activation_trace.role: دفع الضرر بوقاية anchors the focus in active harm-prevention.
تذكير مخوِّف يرق له القلب supplies the moral pressure that redirects harmful conduct.
حمل الغير على ما يكرهه supplies imposed agency as the harm that must be blocked.
عفة الفرج المحفوظة supplies the protected sexual integrity desired by the coerced person.

structural_cues: 24:33 places لَا تُكْرِهُوا and إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا in direct opposition.
24:34 follows without an intervening topic marker and summarizes its materials as admonition for the self-protecting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercion opposed to desired protection; I infer the arrow admonition -> refusal to exploit -> another's preserved agency. Adjacency may instead make 24:34 a summary of the whole preceding unit rather than this prohibition alone.

changed_reading.before: The admonition helps morally cautious readers protect themselves.
changed_reading.after: The admonition also forms protectors who refuse coercion and preserve another person's agency and integrity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus names clarifying signs and an exemplar, the lamp passage builds disclosure through containment, transparency, and layered light, then explicitly depicts parables. Analogy thus functions as an optical apparatus that renders relations visible.

activation_trace.role: كشف المعنى بالقول أو العلامة anchors the focus in mediated disclosure.
المثل المضروب supplies analogy as the disclosure medium.
الضياء والإضاءة supplies the visible content transmitted through the comparison.
المِشكاة كوة المصباح supplies a containing aperture that shapes how light is seen.
الزجاجة الشفافة supplies transparent mediation rather than unframed glare.
تصوير المثل وإظهاره explicitly makes parable-production an act of depiction.

structural_cues: 24:35 is the first ayah after the focus and develops a niche-lamp-glass-light sequence.
The same ayah closes with وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent optical construction and explicit parable-making; I infer analogy -> arranged visibility -> clarification. The lamp passage can remain an independent parable, so the transfer to the focus's historical exemplar is functional rather than identity of referent.

changed_reading.before: The historical example supplements direct explanation with an illustration.
changed_reading.after: The example itself is a calibrated viewing device: its framing and correspondences make otherwise diffuse moral relations visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alternation passage names lesson-taking as transferring one condition across to another under perceptive insight. This activates the focus's departed exemplar as a bridge by which the reader crosses from a former people's condition into diagnosis of the present.

activation_trace.role: المثل عبرة وآية anchors the focus exemplar in lesson-bearing transfer.
مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن supplies the temporal gap that the transfer crosses.
رد الشيء عن وجهه supplies reversal of the viewed condition.
الاتعاظ بجعل حال عبرة لحال supplies the explicit operation of making one state a lesson for another.
بصيرة القلب supplies the inward sight required to complete the transfer.

structural_cues: 24:44 moves from the reversal of night and day to لَعِبْرَةً لِأُولِي ٱلْأَبْصَارِ.
The focus similarly joins a vanished past, an exemplar, and admonition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversal, cross-state lesson, and insight; I infer former condition -> analogical crossing -> present self-recognition. The alternative is that 24:44 models lesson-taking generally without specifying the historical direction used in 24:34.

changed_reading.before: The past is an object the present looks back at.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar is a crossing operation that carries a former condition into present self-recognition and can reverse the reader's viewpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later promise makes prior peoples a succession pattern in which one community stands after another and fear is exchanged for security. The focus's historical exemplar can therefore be promissory as well as cautionary.

activation_trace.role: المثل عبرة وآية keeps the predecessor pattern anchored as a lesson-sign.
مضي الزمن وذهاب القرن supplies the vacated historical position.
وعد يفتح رجاء الموعود بقول supplies an explicitly hopeful future orientation.
شيء يأتي بعد شيء ويقوم مقامه supplies succession into a predecessor's place.
تقدم الشيء أو إقباله identifies the earlier communities as precedent in the same temporal branch as the focus.
قيام شيء مقام شيء آخر supplies the transformation from one social condition to another.
ذعر يتوقع المكروه supplies the condition to be replaced.
سكون القلب في أمن وثقة couples the believing recipients with the promised security.

structural_cues: 24:55 says كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ.
The same ayah gives the directional sequence مِن بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, succession like those before, and fear-to-security replacement; I infer predecessor pattern -> warranted hope. A live alternative is that the focus's مَوْعِظَة foregrounds caution while the promissory force belongs only to the later promise.

changed_reading.before: Former peoples mainly warn the present through failure and consequence.
changed_reading.after: Former peoples can also furnish a hopeful succession precedent in which protected order replaces fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated clarification formula follows a protocol that divides household time, gates entry by permission, and names vulnerable intervals. Clear signs protect by making thresholds legible and actionable.

activation_trace.role: انفصال الشيء وافتراقه anchors clarification in the making of distinctions.
دفع الضرر بوقاية gives those distinctions a protective function.
الإذن والترخيص بالأمر supplies a permission gate at the household boundary.
جعل وقت معلوم للفعل supplies deliberate temporal segmentation.
العَوْرة المستورة supplies the vulnerability the segmented times protect.
كشف المعنى بالقول أو العلامة explicitly labels the protocol as clarification.
علامة ظاهرة identifies the clarified protocol as signs.

structural_cues: 24:58 enumerates three permission times and calls them ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ لَّكُمْ.
24:58 and 24:59 both close the privacy protocol with كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَاتِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permission, fixed times, vulnerability, and the repeated clarification formula; I infer clarification -> visible threshold -> prevention of intrusion. The alternative is that this is one local application rather than a general mechanism of every clarifying sign.

changed_reading.after: Clear signs also engineer temporal and social thresholds so that vulnerability can be protected in practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Another recurrence of the clarification formula removes hardship and permits eating together or separately across a broad house network. Clarification therefore calibrates boundaries in both directions: it can open access and release false constraint, not only restrict.

activation_trace.role: الوصلة القائمة بين الأطراف preserves connection as a live counterpart to separation.
الضيق والحرج supplies the constraint explicitly negated for several persons.
انفراج المغلق واتساع المدخل supplies opening through the possessed keys.
ضم المتفرق حتى يصير شيئا مجموعا supplies permitted communal gathering.
التفرق والشتات supplies the equally permitted separate mode.
كشف المعنى بالقول أو العلامة explicitly marks these releases as divine clarification.
علامة ظاهرة identifies the released options as signs made visible.
العَقْل الحابس عن الجهل makes understanding, rather than maximal restriction, the intended restraint.

structural_cues: 24:61 repeatedly negates حَرَجٌ before permitting a wide household eating network.
It permits جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا and then invokes the same clarification-of-signs formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies removed hardship, opened access, plural social modes, and explicit clarification; I infer clarification -> calibrated permission -> social ease. The alternative is that these are narrow exemptions and do not revise the dominant boundary-setting function.

changed_reading.before: Protective clarification primarily adds limits and separations.
changed_reading.after: Protective clarification also removes needless barriers, leaving distinct but equally legitimate forms of participation open.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because مَثَلًا ordinarily activates analogy, yet the focus root's B002 preserves punitive exemplarity and the surah's opening skin-striking punishment makes deterrence live. It remains anchored in مَثَلًا and مَوْعِظَةً, but downstream prose should present it only as branch-level resonance, not claim that the focus noun denotes mutilation or that every predecessor model is punitive.

activation_trace.role: المثلة والنكال supplies consequence made exemplary so that others recoil.
تذكير مخوِّف يرق له القلب supplies the deterrent uptake without fixing the exemplar as bodily punishment.
ضرب يصيب الجلد وجلاد بالسلاح supplies an embodied public consequence near the surah's opening.
العذاب إيلام وعقوبة names that consequence as punishment witnessed by a group.

changed_reading.before: The past example is only an illustrative comparison.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, exemplarity may include deterrent visibility: consequence itself becomes a pattern from which observers learn to recoil.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it transfers a meteorological process to revelation. It remains anchored by the exact ن ز ل recurrence and a packet-supplied sequence of driven, joined, piled cloud and descending rain; downstream prose should call it a material analogy for staged disclosure, not a lexical definition of أَنزَلْنَا.

activation_trace.role: هبوط الشيء وحلوله anchors the focus in descent that arrives and settles.
ظهور الشيء وانكشافه supplies the resulting emergence into visibility.
دفع الشيء وسوقه برفق supplies the first controlled motion in cloud formation.
ضم الشيء إلى الشيء والتأليف supplies composition of dispersed material.
تجمع الشيء بعضه فوق بعض supplies layered accumulation before release.
الوَدْق مطر نازل supplies the visible output emerging from the assembled cloud.
إنزال الشيء وإيصاله repeats delivery from above inside the material sequence.

changed_reading.before: Clarifying signs arrive as an already complete deposit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clarity precipitates: dispersed elements are driven together, layered, and then released into a form that reaches and becomes visible to recipients.

strongest_changes: 24:17 turns historical likeness into a recurrence-control mechanism rather than a static illustration.
24:55 keeps a promissory predecessor pattern alive beside the cautionary one.
The repeated clarification formula makes clarity practical in opposite directions: it builds protective thresholds in 24:58-59 and releases needless constraint in 24:61.
24:35 and 24:44 make exemplar-reading an arranged act of seeing and cross-temporal transfer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the focus formula operational: signs do not merely state, but orient, shield, open, stage perception, and carry conditions across time. The strongest surprise was that the same predecessor-language can warn against recurrence and authorize hope through succession without forcing either reading to absorb the other.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 24:17's recurrence logic should remain local to the slander episode or govern the focus's historical exemplar more broadly.
How strongly the adjacent lamp construction should control the mechanism of the focus's مَثَلًا.
Whether the promissory succession of 24:55 belongs inside مَوْعِظَةً or stands as a later counterweight to its warning force.
The punitive and meteorological readings remain contained branch-level activations rather than preferred construals.
